# Sinon.JS

> Sinon.js documentation

## Table of Contents

### Fake timers

- [Fake timers](/concepts/fake-timers.md): Replace setTimeout, setInterval, Date, and Temporal with controllable fake implementations.
- [clock.tick](/concepts/fake-timers/tick.md): Advances the clock by the specified time in milliseconds.
- [clock.restore](/concepts/fake-timers/restore.md): Restores the original timer functions.
